definitions.explanation: To apply a new coat of paint over an existing surface; to change the color by repainting.
(Figurative) To replace an existing record or history with a new one; to set a new record.

examples.japanese: ⟦{壁|かべ}→壁：01290_kabe⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{白|しろ}く→白い：00587_shiroi⟧{塗|ぬ}り{替|か}えた。
⟦{古|ふる}く→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦{外壁|がいへき}→外壁：06426_gaiheki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{塗|ぬ}り{替|か}える⟦{時期|じき}→時期：03269_jiki⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: It's time to repaint the old exterior walls.

⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{塗|ぬ}り{替|か}える⟦{大発見|だいはっけん}→大発見：28152_daihakken⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive). Compound verb: ⟦{塗|ぬ}る→塗る：01174_nuru⟧ + ⟦{替|か}える→替える：13399_kaeru⟧.

PATTERN: X⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{塗|ぬ}り{替|か}える (repaint X / rewrite X)

COMPOUND VERB PATTERN: ～⟦{替|か}える→替える：13399_kaeru⟧ compounds indicate replacing or redoing:
・⟦{書|か}き{替|か}える→書き替える：29507_kakikaeru⟧ (to rewrite)
・⟦{作|つく}り{替|か}える→作り替える：16192_tsukurikaeru⟧ (to remake)
・⟦{入|い}れ{替|か}える→入れ替える：08227_irekaeru⟧ (to replace)

FIGURATIVE USE: Very common in sports journalism when describing record-breaking achievements.
